errors.text_span: The “LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit” series is a solid yellow line with circular markers, starting near 0% at Layer1-4, dipping to about −1% at Layer5-12, returning to about 0% at Layer13-20, sitting slightly below 0% (around −0.5%) at Layer21-28, and ending slightly above 0% (around +0.5%) at Layer29-32.
errors.evidence: The yellow series is close to 0% at Layer1-4, around -1% at Layer5-12, about -0.2% at Layer13-20, about -0.5% at Layer21-28, and about +0.5% at Layer29-32; the main mismatch is the implication it returns to exactly 0% at Layer13-20, which is slightly below zero.

errors.text_span: The “RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit” series is a solid light-blue line with circular markers, near 0% (slightly negative) at Layer1-4, around −2.5% at Layer5-12, reaching its lowest point near −6% at Layer13-20, rising to around −4% at Layer21-28, and ending around −1% at Layer29-32.
errors.evidence: The light-blue series is approximately -0.5%, -2.7%, -6%, -4%, and -1% across the five layer groups, so this description is broadly accurate but approximates the first and second points slightly.

errors.text_span: The “LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit” series is a solid red line with square markers, starting just above 0% at Layer1-4, dropping to about −2.5% at Layer5-12, moving to around −2% at Layer13-20, staying near −2% at Layer21-28, and ending near 0% (slightly negative) at Layer29-32.
errors.evidence: The red series is approximately 0.2%, -2.5%, -2.0%, -2.0%, and -0.2%; this is mostly accurate, but 'ending near 0% (slightly negative)' is somewhat loose relative to the plotted value just below zero.

errors.text_span: The “RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit” series is a solid dark-blue line with square markers, starting around −1% at Layer1-4, decreasing to about −5.5% at Layer5-12, reaching its minimum near −14.5% at Layer13-20, rising to about −11% at Layer21-28, and ending around −1.5% at Layer29-32.
errors.evidence: The dark-blue series is approximately -1%, -5.5%, -14.5%, -11%, and -1.5%; this is accurate to the figure, with no substantive error.
